inspiration: Title-screen flame curtain: a heat-indexed palette with occasional whole-palette cross-fades. Keep the heat palette and the occasional cross-fade; use a zone-tinted ember ramp with timers in seconds. Known defect: timers step per frame, so speed follows frame rate.

Procedural instruments: each instrument is a small set of envelopes, vibrato, gate and filter, plus a delay, synthesised when played. Keep the parameter-set idea so sound variety is data; ours uses oscillator presets in data for the browser.

Piecewise envelope: a list of levels and ramp times with linear ramps and a held last level. Keep the list shape for attack, hold and decay. Known defect: a zero-length segment keeps the old slope; fix by zeroing the slope.

Corner-blended ground: four corner colours per plain tile, blended from neighbours, with a separate shaped record for paths. Keep the corner blend and the path overlay; ours is a textured ground with paths as decals.
Heading minimap: the minimap turns with camera heading and shows dot classes and a capped list of hint icons. Keep heading rotation and dot classes; add a north-up toggle and larger touch targets.
Per-kind definitions: one definition reader per content kind, reading its own fields. Keep one definition class per kind; ours are JSON rows.
Whitelist before block: a whitelist is checked before a word filter blocks a name. Keep the rule for player names; use our own list.
